title: GT23D-Bench: A Comprehensive General Text-to-3D Generation Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-view image-based models and native 3D models on visual realism and stylistic properties to identify tendencies toward cartoon-like or stylized outputs stemming from underlying dataset biases and 2D diffusion priors.

Measuring the correlation (Pearson, Spearman, Kendall coefficients) between existing automated metrics (like GPT-based subjective scoring) and genuine human perception ratings to expose model-induced biases in automated text-to-3D evaluation frameworks.

Assessing different 3D generation architectures across semantic alignment and geometric fidelity metrics to analyze the intrinsic inductive biases introduced by different 3D output formats (e.g., multi-view images vs. explicit point clouds vs. implicit neural fields).
